_why: Skill-candidates row 'a corpus-wide mutation sweep verb (`--sweep`)': a hand-rolled loop had covered 11 of 92 specs, and completing it found 2 SURVIVED and 1 REFUSED. `--sweep` runs every spec and summarises; these rows prove the tests bite if it keeps going past a held tree, counts a non-measurement as caught, or certifies an empty corpus.

mutations.name: a-busy-tree-does-not-stop-the-sweep
mutations._mechanism: Every later spec answers BUSY too, and the corpus summary is built from non-measurements.

mutations.name: an-unmeasured-spec-counts-as-caught
mutations._mechanism: A REFUSED spec (drifted anchor) is folded into all_caught and the corpus reads ALL_CAUGHT.
mutations.find: key = verdict.lower() if verdict in _MEASURED else "unmeasured"
mutations.replace: key = verdict.lower() if verdict in _MEASURED else "all_caught"

mutations.name: an-unmeasured-spec-exits-0
mutations._mechanism: The summary says unmeasured=1 but the exit says success, so a script reading $? is fooled.
mutations.find: return 0 if swept and not counts["unmeasured"] else 2

mutations.name: survivors-read-as-all-caught
mutations._mechanism: A SURVIVED spec, the finding the sweep exists to surface, is hidden in the headline.
mutations.find: head = "ALL_CAUGHT" if counts["all_caught"] == swept and swept else "NOT_ALL_CAUGHT"
mutations.replace: head = "ALL_CAUGHT" if counts["unmeasured"] == 0 and swept else "NOT_ALL_CAUGHT"

mutations.name: an-empty-corpus-is-certified
mutations._mechanism: Discovery that found nothing prints a summary instead of saying nothing was swept.
